name: @heyditto/cli
stderr:
Usage: heyditto [options] [command]

Save, search, fetch, and traverse Ditto memories from the shell.

Options:
  -v, --version                                           print the CLI version
  -h, --help                                              display help for command

Commands:
  save [options] <content...>                             save a memory
  search [options] <query...>                             search private memories, optionally public workspaces
  aggregate|aggregate_memories [options] <group-by>       count and group memories
  fetch [options] <id...>                                 fetch memories by id
  list [options]                                          list memories or public publishes
  my-memories|list_my_memories [options]                  list only your saved memories
  update [options] <id>                                   update a saved memory
  publish [options] <id>                                  publish a memory to DittoHub
  unpublish [options] [id]                                remove an existing public share
  delete|delete_memory [options] <memory-id>              permanently delete a saved memory
  subjects [options] <query...>                           search the subject graph
  subject-edges|get_subject_edges [options] <subject-id>  list related subjects for a subject
  memories [options] <subject-id...>                      fetch memory previews for subjects
  network [options] <pair-id>                             traverse related memories
  friends|list_friends [options]                          list Ditto friends
  knowledge-graphs|list_knowledge_graphs [options]        list readable workspaces
  graph-sharing|set_knowledge_graph_sharing [options]     configure workspace sharing
  graphs                                                  manage workspace subscriptions
  init [options] [workspace...]                           initialize a claimable agent account
  login [options] [key]                                   sign in through your browser (device flow) or save an API key
  endpoints|profiles                                      manage inference endpoints
  apps                                                    developer apps: Sign in with Ditto, branded consent and app-owned Router endpoints
  receipts [options]                                      your receipts by billing leg (ditto | byok | covered) and by the app that spent them
  orgs                                                    organizations
  mcp                                                     organization tool servers
  approvals                                               tool approvals
  review                                                  manage and follow Ditto Review
  claude [options] [args...]                              launch Claude Code through a Ditto endpoint
  codex [options] [args...]                               launch Codex through a Ditto endpoint
  grok [options] [args...]                                launch Grok through a Ditto endpoint
  codex-app [options]                                     wire the Codex desktop app to a Ditto endpoint
  session                                                 manage the explicit MCP session
  teleport [options] [path]                               teleport repos + session to Ditto Cloud
  offload [options] [path]                                free disk: back up then remove a local project
  storage                                                 storage mirrors (bring your own bucket)
  fork [options] <session>                                fork a coding session
  repo                                                    scaffold, validate and inspect a repository's .ditto/ configuration
  agents [options]                                        list Ditto agents
  sessions [options]                                      list coding-agent sessions
  logout [options]                                        delete the saved API key
  status [options]                                        show CLI auth and endpoint status
  config [opt
